acceptanceCriteria: MCP impact and context accept a bounded budgetBytes argument with the CLI's semantics, covered by a conformance case.
Rows dropped by MAX_EVIDENCE are counted separately from budget omissions and the reason text names the right cause.
tools/list carries the snapshot sub-schema once (by reference or shared definition); measured bytes before/after retained.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

V1-0944 (docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0944-impact-mcp-caps.md, Limits) capped per-result references but left three gaps: (1) the MCP impact/context tools expose no budgetBytes argument, so MCP callers cannot bound packet bytes the way the CLI can; (2) builder-level MAX_EVIDENCE truncation happens before the cap and is not counted, so the reported omitted count understates what was dropped, and the 'omitted by packet budget' wording misattributes the cause; (3) tools/list repeats the snapshot sub-schema (about 600 B per listing).

holds.reason: Owner/design decision needed per the 2026-10-21 lane report.

title: corvint impact and MCP: budgetBytes argument, count MAX_EVIDENCE truncation, dedupe tools/list snapshot sub-schema
